layman_headline: Market fear is elevated and none of today's swing candidates offer a clean enough setup to risk money on.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 27 out of 100, and while that has improved slightly from yesterday's 25, the overall trend is still worsening. Bitcoin is holding steady around $64,700 with modest gains, but altcoins are struggling under high Bitcoin dominance (56.6%). The swing trade candidates today are either already extended after big runs (BTW up 91%, UB up 17%), beaten down with no chart data to confirm a bottom (KAITO down 30%, LDO down 16%), or simply lacking enough technical data to build conviction. Without clear RSI readings, MACD signals, or chart patterns on most candidates, entering a position would be guessing rather than trading.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market mood is fearful and today's opportunities don't have strong enough setups to justify the risk. Watch for Bitcoin to either break convincingly above $66,000 or pull back to $62,000 support — either scenario could create better entries in the days ahead.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 27 is just above the 25 threshold where Rule #3 says outlook is genuinely ambiguous. The worsening trend (week avg 26.7, declining) suggests we could breach 25 soon. Most swing candidates lack RSI, MACD, and chart analysis data — only UB has a complete chart picture but its R/R of 0.48x violates basic swing trade principles (want >2.0x). BTW's 91% weekly gain is classic overextension territory. LDO and KAITO show sharp declines but without support/resistance levels or RSI to confirm oversold conditions, these are knife-catching setups. BTC dominance at 56.6% actively suppresses alt performance, making alt swing trades higher risk. The signal credibility data shows RSI is the most reliable indicator (71% win rate), yet RSI is only available for UB (neutral at 56) — reinforcing the decision to wait for better data coverage.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed could deteriorate below 25, triggering broader sell-off that drags all candidates lower
High BTC dominance (56.6%) means altcoin positions face headwinds even if BTC is stable

ADA momentum — already +16.9% on the week in a fearful market, which is notable relative strength worth monitoring for a pullback entry
